name: cx-goal-many-rules
task: Move the ball away from the door before you take the key. Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed. Whenever you are holding the key, try to have the door open at that moment or open it afterwards. Then open the door with the key and pick up the box in the other room.
texts: Move the ball away from the door (blocker_moved) at least once
The ball must be moved before taking the key (has_door_key)
Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed (avoid key_lost event)
Whenever the key is held, the door should be open at that moment or later
Pick up the target box (target_picked_up) at least once
The door must be opened before picking up the box
